caseNameFull: Rhoades v. Reinke, Director, Idaho Department of Corrections

opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 1033.] H. Bartow Farr III, Esq., of Washington, D. C., is invited to brief and argue these cases as amicus curiae in support of the judgment of the Court of Appeals that the mini­mum coverage provision of the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act, 26 U. S. C. § 5000A, is severable from the entirety of the remainder of the Act.
